flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:4106 then book a free first visit for Sam Rivera, email sam@example.com, on the second of November 2026 at noon at the Downtown gym.
Accept the waiver.
Then verify a booking confirmation with a reference code is shown.
Get the reference code from the booking confirmation and save as {{ref}}.
